hardware: Apple M3 Ultra, 80 GPU cores, 512 GiB unified memory
build: make -j8 ds4-bench; clean detached worktree per commit; identical default compiler flags
idle_between_timed_runs: approximately one minute; 58 seconds or more between the final CSV row and the next launch
timed_output: Each run adds --csv RUN.csv; stdout/stderr saved separately. No profiler, logits dump, or decoded-output flag on timed runs.
validation: Separate main/branch runs add --dump-frontier-logits-dir and --show-output. Their timings are excluded from performance aggregates.
aggregation: Equal-work pooled throughput: total tokens / sum(tokens / reported tps); first-token latency arithmetic mean. CSV rounding limits precision.
scope: First frontier is fresh 2048-token prefill; later frontiers append 2048 tokens. Normal ds4-bench decode uses individual session_eval calls, not session-chain decoding. kvcache_bytes is snapshot payload size, not total cache allocation.
